summary: I lead the club: I set its direction and oversee its technical programs. I focus on giving students chances to learn, compete and work on practical problems in AI and data science.
Designed and trained a two-stage crater detection and segmentation pipeline on Chandrayaan-2 terrain-model (DTM) imagery. It reaches 0.83 mIoU on lunar crater tiles.

Built XGBoost price-forecasting models for non-perishable commodities across the APMC markets of Gujarat. They beat the seasonal-naive baseline by 40% on held-out seasons. I also developed procurement-timing signals for 20 collection centers, and shipped a daily pipeline that ingests arrivals and prices for 200+ commodity-market pairs.
Co-organized HACKaMINeD 2026, a national hackathon with 1,000+ participants from across India. Helped deliver a two-day workshop on end-to-end machine learning and deep learning for 100+ students.

Helped found the chapter at Nirma University and shaped its technical direction around agentic AI. Led "Hire Your First Research Agent", a hands-on session for 50+ students on building and automating research workflows with n8n and Google ADK.
